# alberyt.xyz

> Personal site of Albert Gabor, a first-year AI student at West University of Timișoara (Romania) who works on machine learning, security and self-hosting. He led his team's build at HackTM 2026, which won the Product Innovation track.

The site lists his projects, his homelab, events he has taken part in, and how to contact him. It is self-hosted on his own hardware and available in English and Romanian.

## About
- Got into AI through neuroscience, then moved into machine learning and security.
- First-year BSc in Artificial Intelligence at West University of Timișoara (UVT), started 2026.
- Artificial Intelligence Olympiad, national stage (2025, 2026). Cybersecurity Olympiad, national stage (2025). Both are national-stage qualifications, not prizes.
- Plays CTFs. Cambridge C1 Advanced (2025).
- Open to internships, research with professors, freelance websites and automations for small businesses, and CTF teams and hackathons.

## Projects
- [EHDS-Service](https://github.com/Albert-4096/EHDS-Service): converts Romanian hospital discharge PDFs into valid HL7 FHIR R4 bundles for the European Health Data Space, using a 9-stage extraction pipeline (Python, FastAPI, React, TypeScript). Built at HackTM 2026, his first hackathon. Albert led the build with his team, and it won the Product Innovation track (€2,000, sponsored by Aumovio). Live demo with a synthetic patient: https://ehds.alberyt.xyz
- K-Project (private repository): 5,500+ saved YouTube videos turned into a searchable corpus (captions or Whisper transcripts, bge-m3 embeddings, hybrid search in PostgreSQL with pgvector), queried by Claude Code over MCP.
- [Cryptography Atlas](https://crypto.alberyt.xyz): a small visual guide to several cryptographic algorithms, their uses and quirks (React, Vite). Source: https://github.com/Albert-4096/cryptography-atlas
- [mail-platform](https://github.com/Albert-4096/mail-platform): personal webmail for own-domain email on top of Resend (Next.js, PostgreSQL, required TOTP).
- [LCG Visualizer](https://lcg.alberyt.xyz): renders a linear congruential generator's output as a grayscale image and checks its parameters against the Hull–Dobell theorem. Source: https://github.com/Albert-4096/LCG-Visualizer-Website
- [Nonlinear Thinking](https://nonlinear-thinking.alberyt.xyz): a guide to habits, environment and exercises for nonlinear thinking.
- [Auth System](https://github.com/Albert-4096/auth-system): a small dockerized authentication backend (Node.js, Express, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Argon2, JWT).
- Guest check-in desk for TEDxAristide Demetriade (private repository, 2026).
- Open-source contributions, both merged in September 2026: [NandhaKishorM/laya#264](https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/264) (treat an empty HF_TOKEN as no token) and [Freika/dawarich#3595](https://github.com/Freika/dawarich/pull/3595) (warn at startup when a self-hosted instance runs in development mode).

## Homelab
- Self-hosting since January 2024 (his first Linux install and first Ubuntu server).
- An always-on Lenovo ThinkCentre mini PC running Ubuntu 24.04, with about 130 Docker containers behind Nginx Proxy Manager.
- A Dell PowerEdge R610 (Proxmox) that is mostly powered off and wakes up once a week to run Proxmox Backup Server.
- Services include n8n, Immich, Jellyfin, Home Assistant, Paperless, SearXNG, Pi-hole, CrowdSec, fail2ban, self-hosted Umami analytics (opt-in only), and a Tor mirror of this site.
